name: Broadbeard beardtongue
desc: Broadbeard beardtongue (Penstemon angustifolius): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Penstemon angustifolius is a perennial semi-evergreen forb belonging to the plantain family. This species is 1 out of roughly 273 species of Penstemon.
